items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to the confidentiality of certain information submitted to the department of agriculture and markets
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S771

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to the
confidentiality of certain information submitted to the department of
agriculture and markets

PURPOSE:
Provides that certain information pertaining to registration and
identification of premises and animals which is collected and
maintained by the Department of Agriculture and Markets is to remain
confidential.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
Section 95-a of the Agriculture and Markets Law is amended to require
certain information pertaining to registration and identification of
premises and animals which is collected and maintained by the
Department of Agriculture and Markets remain confidential. The
Department of Agriculture and Markets may disclose such data provided
that the Department determines disclosure is needed for protection of
public or animal health and safety.

JUSTIFICATION:
Currently, information collected by the Department of Agriculture and
Markets with regard to their ongoing premises/animal identification
program is available to the public following a FOIL request. This
information includes location of animal production premises and
individual animal identification including production and health
data. This information should be viewed as proprietary as it supports
producer participation and disclosure and, potentially, provides data
to persons looking to cause biosecurity difficulties on farms.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
2009-2010:  S.2420/A.7886 Passed Senate

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

summary: Provides that the information collected and maintained by the department of agriculture and markets relating to the registration and identification of premises and animals shall be confidential.
title: Provides that the information collected and maintained by the department of agriculture and markets relating to animals shall be confidential
